His gravestone, which spells his given name ''Absalom'', records that he died on 6 February 1834, aged 35. He was buried in Gilders Creek Cemetery, Newberry County, South Carolina.<ref name="FAG33531766">{{FindAGrave|33531766|sameas=no}}; the memorial includes a photograph of the gravestone.</ref>
